sar.reason: FILE_REPORT recommended (policy section 3a): fraud strongly suspected (verdict: fraud); the activity fits no documented fraud pattern (classified undocumented): repeated same-card purchases within one hour; exposure above $1,000.
sar.narrative: Who: the subject is customer C07297, holder of card C07297-K1. What: 4 transaction(s) totalling $1,906.07 across 1 card(s) were identified as one suspected fraud episode, beginning with transaction 3476602. When: the activity ran from 2016-11-21 to 2016-11-21, and the transaction under review occurred on 2016-11-21. Where: the activity was online, with the reviewed transaction billed in billing region 264. How: repeated same-card purchases of $400 to $500 under product code C occurred within one hour. Why suspicious: the activity matches no documented fraud type and consists of repeated same-card purchases of $400 to $500 within one hour; the total exceeds $1,000. Recommended next actions (recommendations only, none executed): BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT. All identifiers and amounts are taken from the bank's transaction records as they stood when the case was opened.
